caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object with a central vertical stem that branches out into three curved legs, each ending in a rounded foot, giving it a tripod-like stance. From the upper section of the central stem, a horizontal arm extends outwards, supporting a cylindrical cup or holder at its end. The object is rendered in shades of gray, blue, and brown, with subtle highlights to suggest its metallic surface and rounded contours. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background, with no additional objects or text present, and the shading below the object suggests it is resting on a flat surface.
title: Candle Holder
